LanguageData.CS_Kandra_TakeFormDesc: Rearrange into one of the bodies this kandra has eaten. Takes ten seconds. Forms known: {COUNT}.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_NoFormsYet: This kandra has not taken anyone's bones yet.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_RevertDesc: Drop the borrowed shape. Others find the sight of a kandra's own body hard to sit with.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_PickFormTip: Click to take this shape. It takes about ten seconds.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_FreeFormDesc: Put together a face nobody has ever worn. No bones needed; the kandra has done this enough times to invent one.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_FreeFormLocked: Shapeshift {LEVEL} required. Until then it can only wear what it has eaten.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_TrueKind_Crafted: The body it built for itself
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_Note_Crafted: The body it built for itself. Nobody else wears this one.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_Note_Adopted: It gave up the crafted body for this one.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_Note_Wearing: Wearing {FORM}. The shape underneath is still its own.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_EditTrue_NotCrafted: Only a crafted body can be reshaped. This one took a shape it ate.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_ChangeTrue_Nothing: It has eaten nobody. There is nothing else to be.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_PickTrueHint: Pick the shape it returns to.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_PickTrueTip: Click to make this the body it goes back to.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_AdoptBody: The shape it goes back to when it is not wearing anybody. Whatever it is now stays in the list, and it can put that on again whenever it likes.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_NoFormsYetHint: A kandra learns a shape from the bones of the dead. Haul a corpse to it and it will remember the face.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_ReshapeSub: Pick what it is made of
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_GenderReads: The colony will know it as {GENDER}.
